note: 0.3.1 day/night cycle. One cycle = cycle_s real seconds (default 15 min): day_s bright, night_s dark, with dusk/dawn lerps of transition_s at the boundaries. Tint is CanvasModulate on the world only (HUD stays on a CanvasLayer and is not darkened). Hours 0-23 map linearly across the cycle so persona schedules (dawn/day/evening/night) follow the visible clock. Lights (windows, torches) fade in with night. zone_night_floor: minimum tint while the player is in a PK zone at night (0.3.1: the Scorch's embers keep it readable; 0.3.19: the floor is higher so the ash field stays above the night crush; restyle: lifted again for the darker batch 04 ash ground). batch_08_polish: the ground shader no longer squares base tiles, so day/night tints are scaled down (~0.74 day) as a world mood tint to keep the old dark look; overlays/sprites darken with it so road rims match road texture.
